proto-gen.template: Run `make proto-gen` at the repository root. Summarize generated changes and call out any files that should be reviewed before commit.

check-client.template: Run `cd client && npm run check`. Summarize lint/type/format issues and propose minimal fixes.

test-server.template: Run `cd server && go test -v ./...`. Report failing tests first with likely root causes.

test-e2e.template: Run `cd test && npm run test`. Summarize failures with likely flaky vs deterministic classification.
